result:
Perfect! All tests pass now. 

**The bug:** In `tally/invoice.py` line 42, the discount condition was checking `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` when it should be `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:`. The test name "test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units" indicated the discount should apply at exactly 10 units, not strictly greater than 10.

The fix changes the condition to use `>=`, so orders with 10 or more units now correctly receive the 5% bulk discount.
